## Author prompts

**Why this PR exists:** The author asked for the first units of the abstracted Verilex tasks to be built in parallel, then asked for the most valuable next development task to begin with zero-trust validation before merge. This branch implements the scoped read-only stale-proof command from that settled work. The command lists claims whose planned proof cannot be skipped, without launching agents or modifying proof records.

> send claude 'cloud agents' to build the first units of work of those abstracted tasks

> Review the Verilex backlog, determine the most valuable next development task, and initiate work on it. Ensure every Verilex PR goes through zero-trust validation before merging.
